description: This Java source file defines the class CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade, which implements the SignalEnrichmentFacade interface to retrieve additional parts of 'things' asynchronously using a cache. It manages cache lookup, cache updates, and cache invalidation based on incoming signals such as ThingEvent and ThingDeleted, ensuring efficient retrieval and enrichment of data in a clustered environment.

classes.name: CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade
classes.description: A final class that implements SignalEnrichmentFacade to provide asynchronous cache-based retrieval of partial 'thing' data. It manages cache initialization, retrieval, and updates, handling specific signals like ThingEvent and ThingDeleted to maintain cache consistency.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade with specified cache loader, configuration, executor, and cache name prefix.

methods.name: retrievePartialThing
methods.description: Public method that retrieves a partial 'thing' as a JsonObject, considering the type of signal and whether it is a delete event, returning a CompletionStage for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: doRetrievePartialThing
methods.description: Private method that performs the actual retrieval logic, constructing enhanced field selectors and determining whether to use cache or update cache based on the signal type.

methods.name: doCacheLookup
methods.description: Performs cache lookup for a given entity ID and headers, returning a CompletableFuture with the JsonObject or empty.

methods.name: smartUpdateCachedObject
methods.description: Updates the cache entry based on the incoming ThingEvent's revision, handling consistency and cache invalidation if needed.

methods.name: handleNextExpectedThingEvent
methods.description: Handles the case when incoming event has the next expected revision, updating cache accordingly and handling special resource paths.
